## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Implicit SDF
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Bounded function-valued signed distance fields
//  - Placed signed distance fields
//  - Function-valued implicit shapes
//  - Metaballs
//  - SDF modifiers
//  - Sampled signed distance fields
//  - SDF combination trees

//=
// # Bounded function-valued signed distance fields
//
// Analytic SDFs packaged with a conservative AABB for culling, tiling, and
// CSG acceleration. Bounds do not change distance evaluation: Eval /
// DistanceAt always delegate to the inner FunctionSdf. Prefer loose bounds
// over tight ones — incorrect tight bounds cause false culls.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Bounds.
// Related: `SignedDistanceField*` / `BoundedSignedDistanceField*` in
// `implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`; sampled lattices with Bounds below; operators
// in `implicit-sdf.library.plato`.

// A planar function SDF with a conservative bounding rectangle. Outside
// Bounds the solid may be treated as empty for culling; the stored distance
// function is still evaluated on request.
type BoundedSdf2D
    implements IValue, IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField2D
{
    Sdf: FunctionSdf2D;
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
}

// A spatial function SDF with a conservative bounding box. Outside Bounds
// the solid may be treated as empty for culling; the stored distance
// function is still evaluated on request.
type BoundedSdf3D
    implements IValue, IBoundedSignedDistanceField3D, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField3D
{
    Sdf: FunctionSdf3D;
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
}

//==
// # Placed signed distance fields
//
// A source SDF moved off the origin. The distance primitives in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato` are all written centred at the origin and
// axis-aligned, which is what keeps their bodies short and portable; placement is
// this wrapper's job rather than a parameter on every primitive.
//
// Pose and uniform scale, and nothing wider, because these are the only maps that
// carry a signed distance field to another signed distance field: a rigid motion
// preserves distance outright, and a uniform scale multiplies every distance by
// the same factor. Non-uniform scale and shear stretch the pulled-back distance
// by up to their largest factor, so the result can EXCEED the true distance and
// is not a bound at all until divided by that factor; they are deliberately not
// expressible here. Compose an `AffineTransform*D` with the field by hand if
// that is acceptable.
// Operations live in `implicit-sdf.library.plato`.

// A planar SDF placed by a rigid pose and a uniform scale. Distances are the
// source field's multiplied by Scale, so the source's fidelity survives: an
// exact source stays exact. Precondition: Scale is positive.
type PlacedSdf2D
    implements IValue, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField2D
{
    Source: FunctionSdf2D;
    Pose: Pose2D;
    Scale: Number;
}

// A spatial SDF placed by a rigid pose and a uniform scale. The source's
// fidelity survives, as in the planar form. Precondition: Scale is positive.
type PlacedSdf3D
    implements IValue, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField3D
{
    Source: FunctionSdf3D;
    Pose: Pose3D;
    Scale: Number;
}

//==
// # Function-valued implicit shapes
//
// The implicit counterparts of the function-valued fields in
// `fields.types.plato`: a value that STORES the distance function or the
// membership predicate rather than storing data it is derived from. These are
// what the closed-form distance primitives and the CSG combinators in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato` and
// `fields-implicits.library.plato` produce and consume, and they are the
// only implementors of IImplicitRegion2D and IImplicitVolume3D — a predicate has
// nothing to store but its predicate.
//
// A distance field carries strictly more information than a region: every SDF
// induces a region (inside is distance < 0), but a region cannot recover a
// distance. Prefer the SDF form wherever a closed-form distance exists.

// A planar signed distance field defined by a stored distance function:
// negative inside the boundary curve, zero on it, positive outside.
type FunctionSdf2D
    implements IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField2D
{
    Function: Function1<Point2D, Number>;
}

// A spatial signed distance field defined by a stored distance function:
// negative inside the surface, zero on it, positive outside.
type FunctionSdf3D
    implements IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField3D
{
    Function: Function1<Point3D, Number>;
}

// A planar region defined by a stored membership predicate: true inside.
// Carries no distance information.
type FunctionRegion2D
    implements IImplicitRegion2D
{
    Function: Function1<Point2D, Boolean>;
}

// A spatial volume defined by a stored membership predicate: true inside.
// Carries no distance information.
type FunctionVolume3D
    implements IImplicitVolume3D
{
    Function: Function1<Point3D, Boolean>;
}

//==
// # Metaballs
//
// Smooth organic shapes from summed radial falloff kernels
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metaballs). The implicit surface is the level
// set (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Level_set) where the summed influence
// equals the threshold. The falloff kernel and the summation live in
// `fields-implicits.library.plato`.

// A planar metaball: a radial falloff kernel centered at a point. Influence
// is Strength at the center and falls to zero at Radius.
type MetaBall2D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point2D;
    Radius: Number;
    Strength: Number;
}

// A spatial metaball: a radial falloff kernel centered at a point. Influence
// is Strength at the center and falls to zero at Radius. Negative strengths
// carve away from the surface.
type MetaBall3D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Radius: Number;
    Strength: Number;
}
```
